programme.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
programme.desc: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner use Loki's Sceptre to complete Ultron, Tony's AI program. However, when the sentient Ultron makes plans to eliminate mankind, the Avengers set out to stop him.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Lao Luo and his horse achieve instant worldwide fame through a recorded physical altercation against creditors. This veteran performer and his equine companion gain immense popularity after the intense encounter becomes a trend.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: After witnessing extreme bloodshed, Knight George decides to forsake war and seek redemption. However, he is forced to get back to his old ways when he sets out to rescue King Edgar's daughter.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Free Fall
programme.desc: Marie meets skydiver Maxime, who unbeknownst to her is a thief. After his boss Sophia sabotages Marie's parachute, she miraculously survives a 3,000-metre fall and seeks revenge on them.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: Captain Mike Steele leads a team of nearly 100 US Army Rangers who travel to the capital city of Mogadishu to catch the top two lieutenants of a Somali warlord.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: When an advanced Terminator is sent into the past, a cyborg and a seasoned female warrior team up to stop the death of a young woman who is fated to ensure the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin located deep in the forest. When they accidentally summon a dormant demon, they strive to survive its evil ploys.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Eleven-year-old Riley moves to San Francisco, leaving behind her life in Minnesota. She and her five core emotions, Fear, Anger, Joy, Disgust and Sadness, struggle to cope with her new life.

programme.title: BlackBerry
programme.desc: Mike Lazaridis and his best friend Douglas Fregin attempt to revolutionise the communications industry with the world's first smartphone. However, the pair finds themselves jumping several hurdles.

programme.title: Anacondas: Trail of Blood
programme.desc: When an experiment goes wrong, a genetically enhanced anaconda offspring is unleashed. Possessing the power to regenerate, it quickly creates panic and destruction.

programme.title: Ready or Not
programme.desc: Grace, a young bride, finds acceptance in her husband's family through an innocuous game. However, things take a dark turn when the activity becomes deadly.

programme.title: Avengers: Infinity War
programme.desc: The Avengers and their allies set out to stop Thanos, an alien warlord, from acquiring the Infinity Stones as he plans to eliminate half of all life from the universe using them.

programme.title: Avengers: Endgame
programme.desc: After Thanos, an intergalactic warlord, disintegrates half of all life in the universe, the Avengers rally together to reverse his act and defeat him once and for all.

programme.title: Prometheus
programme.desc: A deep-space expedition, led by scientists with conflicting beliefs, follows ancient clues to mankind's origins and faces unimaginable terrors far from home.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Alex, Marty, Gloria, and Melman are back and still trying to return to New York. When their journey brings them to Europe, they use a travelling circus as the perfect cover.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: Michelle accepts a professional role suggested by her advisor. This position confines her within a residence where three deranged relatives attempt to cleanse her soul.

programme.title: Samson
programme.desc: Samson, a Nazirite, takes on the role of rescuing Israelites from the oppression. However, he soon finds himself caught up in the evil machinations of a prince, which leads him to seek revenge.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Unbending Mr. Fang
programme.desc: Fang Shiyu, a martial artist, decides to exact revenge on the corrupt officials who falsely accuse and frame him in a case of corruption.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Seven Swords
programme.desc: Fu Qungzhu and six warriors, including Chu Zhaonan and Yang Yuncong, take a stand against Fire-Wind to defend a village from martial arts persecution.

programme.title: Ferdinand
programme.desc: A bull's peaceful existence comes crashing down when the authorities return him to his former captors. With help from a wisecracking goat and three hedgehogs, the giant but gentle bovine must find a way to escape before he meets a famous bullfighter.

programme.title: The Overnight
programme.desc: Alex, Emily and their offspring, RJ, migrate to Los Angeles where they accidentally encounter the enigmatic Kurt, Charlotte and Max at a public garden. Consequently, a subsequent domestic get-together transforms into a remarkably fascinating event.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: After a devastating flood separates him from his family, Arlo teams up with a young human called Spot as they journey across dangerous lands to find their way home.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a galactic war that shattered the moon and shifted Earth's poles, a massive spaceship named 'Cosmoball' hovers ominously above the planet.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: Stitch, an extraterrestrial entity, comes to planet Earth after he escapes his prison, where he tries to impersonate a dog. Things take a turn when Lilo adopts him from an animal shelter.

programme.title: Ice Age: Collision Course
programme.desc: Scrat accidentally sets off an asteroid to Earth while trying to get his acorn. However, Manny, Sid and Diego join forces with Buck to prevent the asteroid from wiping out their existence.

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: Emelya catches a magical fish that grants him three wishes but foolishly wastes the first two. However, he needs to win Princess Anfisa's hand in marriage without using sorcery for his final request.

programme.title: Dead Poets Society
programme.desc: John Keating, a progressive English teacher, tries to encourage his students to break free from the norm, go against the status quo and live life unapologetically.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: A family vacation takes a detour when workaholic realtor Jim Evers stops to close a deal at a remote mansion. However, they soon realise the estate is haunted by a restless spirit.

programme.title: మాస్క్
programme.desc: శక్తి అనే అమ్మాయిని ఆకట్టుకునే ప్రయత్నంలో బ్రూస్ లీ సూపర్ హీరో వేషం ధరించి తనమార్షల్ ఆర్ట్స్ నైపుణ్యాలను ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.title: మనసు మాట వినదు
programme.desc: అను ప్రేమను గెలుచుకోవడానికి ఇద్దరు ప్రత్యర్థులు వేణు, అమిత్ ఒక హాకీ మ్యాచ్‌లో తమ ప్రేమ వివాదాన్ని పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: అడిక్షన్ కిల్లర్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: ఫన్ టైమ్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: ఈగ
programme.desc: బిందుని ప్రేమించే నానిని అసూయతో వ్యాపారవేత్త సుదీప్ చంపుతాడు.నాని ఈగగా పునర్జన్మించి తన మరణానికి పగతీర్చుకోవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: విక్రమార్కుడు
programme.desc: డబ్బు ఉందనుకున్న పెట్టెలో ఒక బాలికను చూసి షాక్ అయిన సత్తిబాబులా ఉన్న మరో వ్యక్తి కోసం వెతుకుతున్న ముఠా అతడి వెంటపడతాడు.

programme.title: యమదొంగ
programme.desc: తన ప్రియురాలు మహి మేనమామలచే హత్య చేయబడి, యమలోకానికి పంపబడిన అనాథ అయిన రాజా అక్కడ విధ్వంసం సృష్టిస్తాడు.

programme.title: మగధీర

programme.title: பிரிவோம் சந்திப்போம்
programme.desc: விசாலாட்சியை மணந்த நடேசன் வேலைக்காக இடம்மாறியதால், அவரது மனைவி தனிமைக்கு பலியாகி தூக்க மாத்திரைகள் எடுத்து கொண்டார்.

programme.title: இந்தவார கலகலப்பு
programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சித்து +2
programme.desc: காதலித்து சில தவறுகளுக்கு பிறகு பிரிந்த பின்னர், குடும்ப எதிர்ப்பை கடந்து மீண்டும் பவித்ராவின் காதலை பெற போராடுகிறார்.

programme.title: சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.desc: திறமையான இசைக் கலைஞர்கள் தயாரித்து இசையமைத்த பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு அடுத்தடுத்து இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தேனும் பாலும்
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற இசைக்கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு, தமிழ் திரைப்படங்களில் பல்வேறு கலைஞர்கள் நிகழ்த்திய மெல்லிசை பாடல்கள்.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்லாட்
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகிறது.

programme.title: ஏஆர்சி இன்டர்நேஷனல்
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: அழகர் மலை
programme.desc: புகழேந்தி, அவரது மூத்த சகோதரர் பாண்டித்துரைக்கு நேர் எதிரானவர். அவர் எப்போதும் தன்னுடைய சகோதரரைப் பாதுகாக்கிறார்.

programme.title: யாவரும் நலம்
programme.desc: சப்ரா வில்லாவின் 13வது மாடியில் உள்ள ஒரு பிளாட்டுக்கு வந்தபிறகு, ஒரு தொடர் தன் வாழ்க்கையை சித்தரிப்பதை காணும் மனோகர்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: பருத்திவீரன்
programme.desc: தன்னை காப்பாற்றிய ஒரு இளைஞரைக் காதலிக்கும் ஒரு பெண்ணின் வீட்டில் எதிர்ப்பு வரவும், இருவரும் வீட்டைவிட்டு ஓடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: இருவர்
programme.desc: கோலிவுட்டின் பழம்பெரும் ஆளுமைகளான ரஜினிகாந்த்-கமல்ஹாசனின் மறு ஒன்றிணைவை குறிக்கும் வகையில், அவர்களின் படப்பிடிப்பின் பின்னணியில் உள்ள விவரங்களை பற்றி விவாதிக்கும் இயக்குநர்கள்-தொழில் நுட்ப நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: ஈஈ
programme.desc: உயிர் கொல்லி மருந்தை சேரி மக்களுக்கு சோதனை செய்யும் மருத்துவரை தடுத்து, அவனை சட்டத்துக்கு முன் நிறுத்தும் சிறிய ரவுடி ஈ.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.desc: Samantha, a cheerful freelance journalist, and Jay, an up-and-coming chef from the city, throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a huge run-down country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast -- only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents. The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. programme.title: Inspector Vijay
programme.desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

programme.title: Ayodhyapathi Ram
programme.desc: Lord Rama rescues his wife, Sita, from Ravana and returns to Ayodhya. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he exiles Sita, after which she faces several challenges.

programme.title: Ek Aur Gundaraj
programme.desc: A police officer investigates an accident that kills a team of workers. However, things take a turn when he realises that they were murdered.

programme.title: Dashing Kundi
programme.desc: Vicky, a thrill seeker from New York, meets Pramila who falls in love with him. However, her heart breaks when she realises that he does not feel the same way.

programme.title: Aatank Ki Jung
programme.desc: Bringing the best in cinema.

programme.title: Hanuman vs. Mahiravana
programme.desc: Lord Hanuman goes to save Goddess Sita and defeat the king of Lanka, Ravana. To defend his kingdom, Ravana unleashes his most powerful ally, his brother, Mahiravana.

programme.title: Dashing Jigarwala 2
programme.desc: When the students of the Travancore Maharaja College start to form gangs and engage in crime and brutal fights, Edward Livingston, an English professor decides to restore order in the campus.

programme.title: Vijay Raghavan
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer devotes his life to the upliftment of the youth in his locality. However, a corrupt businessman's ploy to poison these young minds compels him to challenge the criminal.

programme.title: Hungama
programme.desc: Balaraju goes to Chinna Babu's house to ask for his daughter's hand in marriage but gets insulted. Balaraju vows revenge and sends two worthless youngsters to woo Chinna and Pedda's daughters.

programme.title: Vishal In Laatti Charge
programme.desc: A police constable lands in grave danger when he gets trapped by a dangerous gang in a building with his sick son. He must strive to defeat the villains and escape to safety.

programme.title: Dashing CM Bharat
programme.desc: Bharat, a graduate from Oxford, is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. He tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.

programme.title: Prince No. 1
programme.desc: Raja falls in love with Rani but breaks off the relationship due to family pressure. Later, when he has all but given up hope of seeing her again, he gets a surprise.
